analyst.summary: ASK Automotive is India's largest two-wheeler braking-systems maker, benefiting from rising safety-regulation content per vehicle and a structural shift toward aluminium lightweighting for EVs - its fastest-growing segment now over half of revenue. FY26 revenue and profit both grew mid-to-high teens, with margins improving on a better product mix even as aluminium input costs rose. The growth story is real, but the stock's valuation already reflects much of that optimism, so this is a name to hold rather than add to at current levels.
